info.title: asana (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Asana REST API. Authorization: Bearer {personal_access_token}. All responses wrap data in a 'data' envelope. GIDs are globally unique identifiers (strings of digits).

post.description: Create a new task in Asana. Associate it with a workspace, and optionally attach it to projects, specify an assignee, set a due date, and apply tags.

200.description: {data: {gid, name, notes, due_on, completed, assignee, workspace, created_at}}

requestBody.description: Body: {name (optional, string), notes (optional, string â€” description), due_on (optional, YYYY-MM-DD), assignee (optional, string â€” user GID or email), completed (optional, bool, default false), tags (optional, array of tag GIDs), projects (optional, array of project GIDs), parent (optional, string â€” parent task GID), workspace (conditional, string â€” workspace GID, required if projects and parent are not specified)}

get.summary: Retrieve all sections belonging to a project. Returns each section's GID and display name.
get.description: Retrieve all sections belonging to a project. Returns each section's GID and display name.

parameters.name: project_gid
parameters.description: The globally unique identifier of the project.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page (max 100).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Token used to paginate through additional results.
